description: Estimate the modeled annual value of a supported premium credit card for a consumer segment. Supply a card slug or name and optionally a segment ID; the default is occasional-traveler. Return segment assumptions, score, rewards, credits, perks, fee, interest, friction, net value, caveats, sources, verification date, freshness and methodology. Gross recovered value is rewards + credits + perks. breakageMultiplier is gross recovered value / advertised value, NOT divided by annual fee. feeRecoveryMultiplier is max(0, gross recovered value - interest drag - rewards friction discount) / annual fee, before subtracting the fee. Friction applies to raw rewards only. Reality Score is 100 * net realized value / advertised value. Ratios are rounded. These are scenario estimates, not personalized advice or guaranteed benefits. Preserve stale or unavailable labels; do not infer that all terms share the observation date. Unknown cards or segments return a structured error with suggestions.

card.description: Card slug or name, e.g. platinum-card or Chase Sapphire Reserve.

segment.description: Optional segment id, e.g. occasional-traveler, small-business-owner, balance-carrier.

name: get_reality_score

asOf.description: ISO timestamp of the underlying data this response reflects.

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp this response was computed at.

breakageMultiplier.description: Gross recovered value (rewards + credits + perks) / advertised value, rounded to two decimals. Annual fee is not this denominator.

feeRecoveryMultiplier.description: max(0, gross recovered value - interest drag - rewards friction discount) / annual fee, rounded to two decimals; before subtracting the annual fee.

realityScore.description: 100 * net realized value / advertised value, rounded to an integer.

realizedValue.description: Rewards + credits + perks minus annual fee, interest drag and rewards friction discount.

redemptionFrictionDiscount.description: Discount applied to raw rewards, not to credits or perks.

title: Card Reality Score
